label: Arah

text.BHSA NEH 6:17: גַּ֣ם׀ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם מַרְבִּ֞ים חֹרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ אִגְּרֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם הֹולְכֹ֖ות עַל־טֹובִיָּ֑ה וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְטֹובִיָּ֖ה בָּאֹ֥ות אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
text.KJV NEH 6:17: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
text.BHSA NEH 6:18: כִּי־רַבִּ֣ים בִּֽיהוּדָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁבוּעָה֙ לֹ֔ו כִּי־חָתָ֥ן ה֖וּא לִשְׁכַנְיָ֣ה בֶן־אָרַ֑ח וִֽיהֹוחָנָ֣ן בְּנֹ֔ו לָקַ֕ח אֶת־בַּת־מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּ֥ן בֶּֽרֶכְיָֽה׃
text.KJV NEH 6:18: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
text.BHSA NEH 6:19: גַּ֣ם טֹובֹתָ֗יו הָי֤וּ אֹמְרִים֙ לְפָנַ֔י וּדְבָרַ֕י הָי֥וּ מֹוצִיאִ֖ים לֹ֑ו אִגְּרֹ֛ות שָׁלַ֥ח טֹובִיָּ֖ה לְיָֽרְאֵֽנִי׃
text.KJV NEH 6:19: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

B.name: Arah
B.line: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:5)
family: descendant-of jacob (Jacob, second-born son of Isaac (GEN 25:25-26))

why: The Hebrew שְׁכַנְיָה בֶן־אָרַח identifies Arah as the father of Shecaniah, Tobiah’s father-in-law, matching A’s stated identity. However, B has the identical family relationship, so the supplied text and records cannot conclusively distinguish them.
